methods.doc: / LAZY CHECK: Check dan expire vouchers yang sudah melewati valid_until Dipanggil setiap user action untuk memastikan data selalu up-to-date PENGGANTI SCHEDULER - WORK DI FTP HOSTING / private function checkAndExpireVouchers() { $expiredVouchers = Approved_Request::where('status', 'approved') ->where('valid_until', '<', now()) ->get(); foreach ($expiredVouchers as $voucher) { try { DB::beginTransaction(); $voucher->update(['status' => 'cancelled']); $permohonan = Permohonan::find($voucher->permohonan_id); if ($permohonan && $permohonan->status === 'approved') { $permohonan->update([ 'status' => 'cancelled', 'requester_notes' => ($permohonan->requester_notes ?? '') . "\n\n[SYSTEM AUTO-CANCEL] Voucher expired, tidak digunakan dalam 50 jam." ]); // ✅ PENALTY: Kurangi 1 slot untuk 3 bulan UserSlotAdjustment::create([ 'user_id' => $permohonan->requester_id, 'type' => 'penalty', 'reason' => 'voucher_expired', 'related_permohonan_id' => $permohonan->id, 'effective_from' => now(), 'effective_until' => now()->addMonths(3), 'is_active' => true ]); \Log::info("❌ Auto-cancelled voucher #{$voucher->id} for request #{$permohonan->id}"); } DB::commit(); } catch (\Exception $e) { DB::rollBack(); \Log::error("Failed to expire voucher #{$voucher->id}: " . $e->getMessage()); } } } / ✅ Calculate max slots for user based on penalties & bonuses / private function calculateUserMaxSlots($userId) { $baseSlots = 5; // Default 5 slots $adjustments = UserSlotAdjustment::where('user_id', $userId) ->where('is_active', true) ->where('effective_from', '<=', now()) ->where('effective_until', '>=', now()) ->get(); $totalAdjustment = 0; foreach ($adjustments as $adjustment) { if ($adjustment->type === 'penalty') { $totalAdjustment -= 1; } elseif ($adjustment->type === 'bonus') { $totalAdjustment += 1; } } $maxSlots = $baseSlots + $totalAdjustment; // Min 1 slot, max 6 slots return max(1, min(6, $maxSlots)); } / ✅ Check if user eligible for reward based on submission history Kriteria: minimal 80% on-time dari 10 permohonan terakhir / private function checkRewardEligibility($userId) { $recentCompletedRequests = Permohonan::where('requester_id', $userId) ->where('status', 'completed') ->with(['approvedRequest', 'transactionProof']) ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc') ->limit(10) ->get(); // Kalau belum ada 10 permohonan, gak eligible (user baru) if ($recentCompletedRequests->count() < 10) { \Log::info("User {$userId} has less than 10 completed requests: " . $recentCompletedRequests->count()); return false; } $onTimeCount = 0; $totalCount = 0; foreach ($recentCompletedRequests as $request) { if (!$request->approvedRequest || !$request->transactionProof) { continue; } $submitTime = $request->transactionProof->created_at; $validUntil = $request->approvedRequest->valid_until; if ($submitTime->lessThan($validUntil)) { $onTimeCount++; } $totalCount++; } if ($totalCount === 0) { return false; } $onTimePercentage = ($onTimeCount / $totalCount) 100; \Log::info("User {$userId} on-time rate: {$onTimePercentage}% ({$onTimeCount}/{$totalCount})"); // Eligible kalau minimal 80% on-time return $onTimePercentage >= 80; } / Generate unique request number Format: REQ-DDMMYYYY-RANDOM6 / private function generateRequestNumber() { $date = now()->format('dmY'); $random = strtoupper(substr(md5(uniqid(rand(), true)), 0, 6)); return "REQ-{$date}-{$random}"; } / Show history of all requests /

methods.doc: / Get expense over time based on period for line chart / private function getExpenseOverTime($period = 'month') { $now = Carbon::now(); switch ($period) { case 'day': // Hourly data for current day $data = Permohonan::whereIn('status', ['completed', 'approved']) ->whereDate('request_date', $now->toDateString()) ->selectRaw('HOUR(request_date) as hour, SUM(bill_amounts) as total') ->groupBy('hour') ->orderBy('hour', 'asc') ->get() ->mapWithKeys(function($item) { return [sprintf('%02d:00', $item->hour) => $item->total]; }) ->toArray(); break; case 'year': // Monthly data for current year $data = Permohonan::whereIn('status', ['completed', 'approved']) ->whereYear('request_date', $now->year) ->selectRaw('MONTH(request_date) as month, SUM(bill_amounts) as total') ->groupBy('month') ->orderBy('month', 'asc') ->get() ->mapWithKeys(function($item) { return [Carbon::create()->month($item->month)->format('M') => $item->total]; }) ->toArray(); break; case 'month': default: // Daily data for current month $data = Permohonan::whereIn('status', ['completed', 'approved']) ->whereYear('request_date', $now->year) ->whereMonth('request_date', $now->month) ->selectRaw('DATE(request_date) as date, SUM(bill_amounts) as total') ->groupBy('date') ->orderBy('date', 'asc') ->pluck('total', 'date') ->toArray(); break; } return $data; } private function getPeriodLabel($period) { $labels = [ 'day' => 'Hari Ini', 'month' => 'Bulan Ini', 'year' => 'Tahun Ini' ]; return $labels[$period] ?? 'Bulan Ini'; } / Calculate stats from filtered transactions collection / private function calculateStats($transactions, $period = 'month') { // Jika tidak ada filter aktif, gunakan getDashboardStatsData biasa if ($transactions->isEmpty()) { return $this->getDashboardStatsData($period); } // Define date range based on period $now = Carbon::now(); switch ($period) { case 'day': $startDate = $now->copy()->startOfDay(); $endDate = $now->copy()->endOfDay(); break; case 'year': $startDate = $now->copy()->startOfYear(); $endDate = $now->copy()->endOfYear(); break; case 'month': default: $startDate = $now->copy()->startOfMonth(); $endDate = $now->copy()->endOfMonth(); break; } return [ // Period info 'period' => $period, 'periodLabel' => $this->getPeriodLabel($period), 'startDate' => $startDate->format('Y-m-d'), 'endDate' => $endDate->format('Y-m-d'), // Total from filtered transactions 'totalExpense' => $transactions->whereIn('status', ['completed', 'approved']) ->sum('bill_amounts'), // Total transactions count 'totalTransactions' => $transactions->count(), 'total' => $transactions->count(), // Alias // Average Request Value 'avgRequestValue' => $transactions->whereIn('status', ['completed', 'approved']) ->avg('bill_amounts') ?? 0, // Average Request Frequency (dari filtered data) 'avgRequestFrequency' => $this->calculateFilteredFrequency($transactions, $period), // Gasoline Distribution (dari filtered data) 'gasolineDistribution' => $transactions->whereIn('status', ['completed', 'approved']) ->groupBy('gasoline_type') ->map(function($group) { return $group->sum('bill_amounts'); }) ->toArray(), // Gasoline Expense Distribution (untuk pie chart) 'gasolineExpenseDistribution' => $transactions->whereIn('status', ['completed', 'approved']) ->groupBy('gasoline_type') ->map(function($group) { return $group->sum('bill_amounts'); }) ->toArray(), // Expense over time (dari filtered data) 'expenseOverTime' => $this->getFilteredExpenseOverTime($transactions, $period), 'vehicleExpense' => $transactions->whereIn('status', ['completed', 'approved']) ->groupBy('consumerial_tools_id') ->map(function($group) { $vehicle = $group->first()->consumerialTool; if (!$vehicle) return null; return [ 'name' => "{$vehicle->consumerial_code} - {$vehicle->consumerial_name}", 'total' => $group->sum('bill_amounts') ]; }) ->filter() ->sortByDesc('total') ->take(10) ->pluck('total', 'name') ->toArray(), 'driverExpense' => $transactions->whereIn('status', ['completed', 'approved']) ->groupBy('requester_id') ->map(function($group) { $driver = $group->first()->requester; if (!$driver) return null; return [ 'name' => $driver->nama_lengkap, 'total' => $group->sum('bill_amounts') ]; }) ->filter() ->sortByDesc('total') ->take(10) ->pluck('total', 'name') ->toArray(), ]; } / Calculate frequency from filtered transactions / private function calculateFilteredFrequency($transactions, $period) { if ($transactions->isEmpty()) { return ['value' => 0, 'label' => 'per hari']; } switch ($period) { case 'day': // Group by hour $grouped = $transactions->groupBy(function($item) { return $item->request_date->format('H'); }); $avgPerPeriod = $grouped->avg(function($group) { return $group->count(); }) ?? 0; $periodLabel = 'per jam'; break; case 'year': // Group by month $grouped = $transactions->groupBy(function($item) { return $item->request_date->format('m'); }); $avgPerPeriod = $grouped->avg(function($group) { return $group->count(); }) ?? 0; $periodLabel = 'per bulan'; break; case 'month': default: // Group by day $grouped = $transactions->groupBy(function($item) { return $item->request_date->format('d'); }); $avgPerPeriod = $grouped->avg(function($group) { return $group->count(); }) ?? 0; $periodLabel = 'per hari'; break; } return [ 'value' => round($avgPerPeriod, 1), 'label' => $periodLabel ]; } / Get expense over time from filtered transactions / private function getFilteredExpenseOverTime($transactions, $period) { if ($transactions->isEmpty()) { return []; } $filtered = $transactions->whereIn('status', ['completed', 'approved']); switch ($period) { case 'day': // Hourly return $filtered->groupBy(function($item) { return $item->request_date->format('H:00'); })->map(function($group) { return $group->sum('bill_amounts'); })->sortKeys()->toArray(); case 'year': // Monthly return $filtered->groupBy(function($item) { return $item->request_date->format('M'); })->map(function($group) { return $group->sum('bill_amounts'); })->toArray(); case 'month': default: // Daily return $filtered->groupBy(function($item) { return $item->request_date->format('Y-m-d'); })->map(function($group) { return $group->sum('bill_amounts'); })->sortKeys()->toArray(); } } / Tampilkan halaman form cetak laporan BBM /

methods.doc: / Calculate average request frequency based on period / private function calculateAvgRequestFrequency($period = 'month') { $now = Carbon::now(); switch ($period) { case 'day': // Average per hour in current day $requests = Permohonan::whereDate('request_date', $now->toDateString()) ->selectRaw('HOUR(request_date) as hour, COUNT( ) as count') ->groupBy('hour') ->get(); $avgPerPeriod = $requests->avg('count') ?? 0; $periodLabel = 'per jam'; break; case 'year': // Average per month in current year $requests = Permohonan::whereYear('request_date', $now->year) ->selectRaw('MONTH(request_date) as month, COUNT( ) as count') ->groupBy('month') ->get(); $avgPerPeriod = $requests->avg('count') ?? 0; $periodLabel = 'per bulan'; break; case 'month': default: // Average per day in current month $requests = Permohonan::whereYear('request_date', $now->year) ->whereMonth('request_date', $now->month) ->selectRaw('DAY(request_date) as day, COUNT( ) as count') ->groupBy('day') ->get(); $avgPerPeriod = $requests->avg('count') ?? 0; $periodLabel = 'per hari'; break; } return [ 'value' => round($avgPerPeriod, 1), 'label' => $periodLabel ]; } private function getDriverStatisticsData() { $stats = Permohonan::with(['requester', 'transactionProof']) ->get() ->groupBy('requester_id') ->map(function ($requests, $requesterId) { $requester = $requests->first()->requester; $nominals = $requests->pluck('bill_amounts')->filter()->toArray(); return [ 'driver' => $requester->nama_lengkap ?? 'Unknown', 'total' => $requests->count(), 'rejected' => $requests->where('status', 'rejected')->count(), 'completed' => $requests->where('status', 'completed')->count(), 'approved' => $requests->where('status', 'approved')->count(), 'pending' => $requests->where('status', 'pending')->count(), 'reportRate' => $requests->count() > 0 ? round(($requests->where('status', 'completed')->count() / $requests->count()) 100, 1) : 0, 'avgNominal' => !empty($nominals) ? array_sum($nominals) / count($nominals) : 0, 'maxNominal' => !empty($nominals) ? max($nominals) : 0, 'minNominal' => !empty($nominals) ? min($nominals) : 0, ]; }) ->values() ->sortByDesc('total'); return $stats; } private function getVehicleFuelConsumptionData(Request $request = null) { $query = Transaction_Proofs::with(['permohonan.consumerialTool', 'permohonan.requester']) ->whereHas('permohonan', function($q) { $q->where('status', 'completed'); }); $proofs = $query->orderBy('purchase_datetime', 'desc')->get(); $result = $proofs->map(function ($proof) { $permohonan = $proof->permohonan; $vehicle = $permohonan->consumerialTool; return [ 'requestNumber' => $permohonan->request_number, 'vehicleId' => $vehicle->id ?? '', 'vehicleDisplay' => $vehicle ? "{$vehicle->consumerial_code} - {$vehicle->consumerial_name}" : '', 'platNumber' => $vehicle->consumerial_code ?? '', 'merk' => $vehicle->consumerial_name ?? 'Unknown', 'gasolineType' => $permohonan->gasoline_type, 'volume' => $proof->fuel_volume, 'nominal' => $permohonan->bill_amounts, 'tanggalPengisian' => $proof->purchase_datetime, 'requestAt' => $permohonan->request_date, ]; }); return $result; } private function getVehicleKmPerformanceData(Request $request = null) { $query = Transaction_Proofs::with(['permohonan.consumerialTool']) ->whereHas('permohonan.consumerialTool', function($q) { $q->where('consumerial_type', 'KENDARAAN'); }) ->where('km_terakhir', '>', 0) ->orderBy('purchase_datetime', 'asc'); $proofs = $query->get(); // Group by vehicle $vehicleKmData = []; foreach ($proofs as $proof) { $vehicleId = $proof->permohonan->consumerial_tools_id; if (!isset($vehicleKmData[$vehicleId])) { $vehicleKmData[$vehicleId] = []; } $vehicleKmData[$vehicleId][] = [ 'km' => $proof->km_terakhir, 'date' => $proof->purchase_datetime, ]; } // Calculate KM differences $result = []; foreach ($vehicleKmData as $vehicleId => $records) { if (count($records) < 2) continue; // Sort by date usort($records, function($a, $b) { return $a['date']->timestamp - $b['date']->timestamp; }); $kmDifferences = []; for ($i = 1; $i < count($records); $i++) { $diff = $records[$i]['km'] - $records[$i-1]['km']; // Sanity check positive difference and less than 10k km if ($diff > 0 && $diff < 10000) { $kmDifferences[] = $diff; } } if (empty($kmDifferences)) continue; $vehicle = VehicleAndToolsConsumers::find($vehicleId); if (!$vehicle) continue; $avgKmDiff = array_sum($kmDifferences) / count($kmDifferences); $result[] = [ 'vehicleId' => $vehicleId, 'vehicleDisplay' => "{$vehicle->consumerial_code} - {$vehicle->consumerial_name}", 'platNumber' => $vehicle->consumerial_code, 'merk' => $vehicle->consumerial_name, 'avgKmDiff' => round($avgKmDiff), 'totalTrips' => count($kmDifferences), 'maxKm' => max($kmDifferences), 'minKm' => min($kmDifferences), 'lastUpdate' => $records[count($records) - 1]['date'], 'latestOdo' => $records[count($records) - 1]['km'], ]; } // Sort by avgKmDiff descending usort($result, function($a, $b) { return $b['avgKmDiff'] - $a['avgKmDiff']; }); return collect($result); } private function getCompletePivotTableData(Request $request = null) { $query = Permohonan::with([ 'requester', 'authorizer', 'consumerialTool', 'transactionProof', 'approvedRequest' ])->whereIn('status', ['approved', 'completed']); $permohonans = $query->orderBy('request_date', 'desc')->get(); $result = $permohonans->map(function ($permohonan) { $vehicle = $permohonan->consumerialTool; $proof = $permohonan->transactionProof; $approved = $permohonan->approvedRequest; return [ 'requestId' => $permohonan->id, 'requestNumber' => $permohonan->request_number, 'driverName' => $permohonan->requester->nama_lengkap ?? 'Unknown', 'vehicleDisplay' => $vehicle ? "{$vehicle->consumerial_code} - {$vehicle->consumerial_name}" : '', 'platNumber' => $vehicle->consumerial_code ?? '', 'merk' => $vehicle->consumerial_name ?? '', 'requestAt' => $permohonan->request_date, 'nominal' => $permohonan->bill_amounts, 'gasolineType' => $permohonan->gasoline_type, 'status' => $permohonan->status, 'voucherCode' => $approved->voucher_code ?? '', 'proofId' => $proof->transaction_id ?? '', 'tanggalPengisian' => $proof ? $proof->purchase_datetime : null, 'volumePengisian' => $proof->fuel_volume ?? 0, 'kmTerakhir' => $proof->km_terakhir ?? 0, 'tanggalLaporan' => $proof ? $proof->created_at : null, ]; }); return $result; } // kendaran rental approval flow // Tambahkan method baru di SuperadminController / Tampilkan dashboard approval kendaraan rental & permohonan /

methods.doc: / Get trip validations data (auto-generated, only for diff_odo >= 300) / private function getAllTripsData() { // Get all vehicles $vehicles = VehicleAndToolsConsumers::where('consumerial_type', 'KENDARAAN') ->where('is_approved', true) ->get(); $allTrips = collect(); foreach ($vehicles as $vehicle) { // Get transaction proofs untuk kendaraan ini $proofs = Transaction_Proofs::whereHas('permohonan', function($q) use ($vehicle) { $q->where('consumerial_tools_id', $vehicle->id) ->where('status', 'completed'); }) ->where('km_terakhir', '>', 0) ->orderBy('purchase_datetime', 'asc') ->get(); // Skip jika kurang dari 2 transaksi if ($proofs->count() < 2) { continue; } // Loop untuk setiap pasangan berurutan for ($i = 0; $i < $proofs->count() - 1; $i++) { $prevProof = $proofs[$i]; $latestProof = $proofs[$i + 1]; $diffOdo = $latestProof->km_terakhir - $prevProof->km_terakhir; // Skip jika tidak masuk akal (KM turun atau terlalu besar) if ($diffOdo <= 0 || $diffOdo > 10000) { continue; } $needsValidation = $diffOdo >= 300; // Cek apakah ada validasi di database (hanya untuk yang >= 300 KM) $validation = null; if ($needsValidation) { $validation = TripValidation::where('transaction_proof_previous_id', $prevProof->id) ->where('transaction_proof_latest_id', $latestProof->id) ->first(); // Kalau belum ada validasi, buat entry baru if (!$validation) { $validation = TripValidation::create([ 'transaction_proof_previous_id' => $prevProof->id, 'transaction_proof_latest_id' => $latestProof->id, 'previous_odo' => $prevProof->km_terakhir, 'latest_odo' => $latestProof->km_terakhir, 'diff_odo' => $diffOdo, 'is_long_trip' => false, 'long_trip_notes' => null, 'validated_by' => null, 'validated_at' => null, ]); $validation->calculateMetrics(); } } $allTrips->push([ 'validationId' => $validation ? $validation->id : null, 'prevProofId' => $prevProof->id, 'latestProofId' => $latestProof->id, 'previousOdo' => $prevProof->km_terakhir, 'latestOdo' => $latestProof->km_terakhir, 'diffOdo' => $diffOdo, 'needsValidation' => $needsValidation, // Validation status (hanya ada jika >= 300 KM) 'isValidated' => $validation ? ($validation->validated_at !== null) : false, 'isLongTrip' => $validation ? $validation->is_long_trip : null, 'longTripNotes' => $validation ? $validation->long_trip_notes : null, 'validatedBy' => $validation && $validation->validator ? $validation->validator->nama_lengkap : null, 'validatedAt' => $validation ? $validation->validated_at : null, 'statusBadge' => $validation ? $validation->status_badge : null, 'statusLabel' => $validation ? $validation->status_label : null, // Info tambahan 'vehicleDisplay' => "{$vehicle->consumerial_code} - {$vehicle->consumerial_name}", 'vehicleCode' => $vehicle->consumerial_code, 'requesterName' => $prevProof->permohonan->requester->nama_lengkap ?? 'Unknown', 'datePrevious' => $prevProof->purchase_datetime, 'dateLatest' => $latestProof->purchase_datetime, 'daysDiff' => $prevProof->purchase_datetime->diffInDays($latestProof->purchase_datetime), 'requestNumberPrev' => $prevProof->permohonan->request_number ?? '-', 'requestNumberLatest' => $latestProof->permohonan->request_number ?? '-', // Hitung efisiensi BBM 'fuelVolume' => $prevProof->fuel_volume, 'fuelEfficiency' => $prevProof->fuel_volume > 0 ? round($diffOdo / $prevProof->fuel_volume, 2) : 0, ]); } } return $allTrips->sortByDesc('diffOdo'); } / Validate single trip / / Validate single trip dengan baseline override /
